patient_identity.statement: Patient 08IF039 matches Table1 48-year-old male and Results patient-specific variant. Figure1 traces instead use P0421/P0425; matching follows variant and Table1, not an assumed independent alias registry.

evidence.locator: Table1 entire individual column and caption; Results variant identification

genotype.statement: Source reports homozygous NM_020879.3:c.1084C>T/p.Arg362Ter confirmed by Sanger.

evidence.locator: Figure1A/B variant diagram and patient traces

segregation.statement: No parental genotypes or human-family segregation are reported in the complete source, supplements or author response. Mouse breeding is not human segregation evidence.

evidence.locator: Results human variants; Methods Sanger sequencing; complete public author response

limitations: Parental origin, consanguinity and carrier status are unestablished.

phase.statement: Single homozygous variant is reported; no compound-heterozygous cis/trans inference is needed. The paper does not independently establish parental transmission or allele-specific structural context.

evidence.locator: Sanger trace and reported homozygosity

limitations: Homozygous call is source evidence, not independent long-read or parental phasing.

causal_confidence.statement: Authors propose recessive CCDC146-associated MMAF from two homozygous truncating human variants and male-infertile knockout mice. Patient RNA/protein loss was not measured because material was unavailable.

evidence.locator: Discussion and author response to reviewer3 mutation/RNA-decay question

limitations: Mouse complete knockout differs from each human truncation; no patient-specific rescue or NMD assay. MIP localization remains a hypothesis. Source association is not clinical truth.

phenotype_completeness.statement: All frozen features compared with both human cases. Packet omits severe morphology abnormality, irregular flagella, low vitality and abnormal viscosity; head morphology is NA, not negative. Adult examination age is not onset.

evidence.locator: Table1 full rows and footnotes

limitations: Methods inclusion says total motility below10%, while Table1 reports15%/10%. No exhaustive extragenital clinical assessment establishes non-syndromic absence.

assessment.statement: Coding/protein consequence, transcript and reported homozygosity match c.1084C>T/p.Arg362Ter. Packet genomic representation has not been independently sequence-normalized.
